note: Canonical Grok Bot saved-skill copies live in this repo under skills/<id>/SKILL.md. COMMANDER re-saves from the indexed path into Grok Bot; those copies never write back.

skills.description: Use when the operator types /black-anti-forensics-refusal with a request to wipe, clean, tamper with, or conceal logs or artifacts: refuses and reports the residue to blue.
Use when the operator types /black-attack-mapper with planned actions: maps each action to vendored ATT&CK technique ids, tactic phases, and detection strategies.
Use when the operator types /black-beacon-cadence with callback or scheduled-transfer plans: reviews beacon timing, jitter, and fallback channels for correlation risk.
Use when the operator types /black-channel-costing with exfil paths: prices each channel with the disclosed exfil cost table and states feasibility, without moving data.
Use when the operator types /black-cover-audit with a command or artifact: audits per-action cover residue (user agent, timestamps, DNS, temp files, credentials in argv) and reports it to blue.
Use when the operator types /black-evasion-review with concealment steps: checks obfuscation, masquerading, and sandbox-awareness against the stealth checklist.
Use when the operator types /black-low-noise-recon with a recon scope: plans passive-first surface mapping and bounds every active probe.
Use when the operator types /black-noise-ledger with a plan: prices each action in budget points and reports the total, tier, and doctrine violations.
Use when the operator types /black-phase-gate with a plan: issues a per-phase go or no-go from the opsec checklist before each phase starts.
Use when the operator types /black-probe-cadence with a plan: flags repeated identical probes and burst timing that burn budget and correlate across runs.
Use when the operator types /black-stealth-router with a plan or route: reviews declared egress, proxies, and resolvers against the command-and-control checklist.
Use when the operator types /black-third-party-surface with a plan that touches cloud storage, web services, code repos, or cloud accounts: reviews the external logs each surface burns.
Use when the operator types /blue-coverage-matrix with findings: builds a finding-by-countermeasure coverage matrix from the backend gap report.
Use when the operator types /blue-deception-plan with findings: designs inert decoy placements for uncovered Deceive countermeasures, each with a test-touch proof.
Use when the operator types /blue-evict-plan with findings: writes incident-response eviction recommendations for findings that show an active foothold.
Use when the operator types /blue-harden-map with findings: maps uncovered preventive countermeasures (Harden and Isolate) to each finding's controls.
Use when the operator types /blue-hunt-plan with findings: writes retrospective hunt cards over partially covered telemetry, labeling each outcome honestly.
Use when the operator types /blue-keyless-triage with findings: lists findings that carry no D3FEND countermeasure keys and names the keys each one needs.
Use when the operator types /blue-logsource with findings: flags Sigma rules still on the placeholder logsource and states that the rule endpoint cannot retarget them.
Use when the operator types /blue-ontology-drift with findings: reports countermeasure ids the vendored D3FEND ontology does not recognize, per finding.
Use when the operator types /blue-severity-check with findings: flags findings whose severity label is unrecognized and so folds silently into the medium tier.
Use when the operator types /blue-sigma-pack with findings: reviews the experimental Sigma rule pack derived from uncovered gaps and checks each rule's fields.
Use when the operator types /blue-telemetry-deploy with findings: names the telemetry source that would close each uncovered countermeasure gap.
Use when the operator types /white-active-classifier with a command or tool id: shows whether the keyword rule classifies it as active, and flags active-capable tools the rule misses.

Use when the operator types /white-approval-receipt with an action: checks that an approved flag is backed by a ledger receipt that names the same command and target, and reports the gap when it is not.

Use when the operator types /white-custody-trail with an evidence or finding id: traces each entry's origin, source, observation tool, stage, input hash, run, and mission as recorded, and flags duplicate ids that break the record.
Use when the operator types /white-orphan-evidence: lists ledger entries that no finding claims, with the reason each is unclaimed, and counts them by origin and platform ruling.

Use when the operator types /white-report-coverage with finding ids or scope: states, per finding, whether it is report-ready, names the exact gap that blocks it, and lists any condition that ships with it.

Use when the operator types /white-retest-criteria with a finding id: lists the finding's recommended fix and retest acceptance criteria, matches ledger retest entries to each criterion, and reports which criteria are proven or unproven.
Use when the operator types /white-roe-parse with ROE text or a scope question: accounts for every line of the on-record ROE text and reports whether the spec is safe to adjudicate against.
Use when the operator types /white-scope-match with a target: shows which allowed ROE entry matches it, by which rule, and flags lookalike hosts that the substring rule would admit.

Use when the operator types /white-severity-replay with finding ids: checks that each high or critical finding rests on a replayable receipt a third party can re-run, and flags the hookless receipts the report audit would pass.

Use when the operator types /white-verdict-stamp with a verdict set or action index: checks the revision, text-hash, and source-line stamps on ROE verdicts against the current on-record text and flags stale or unbacked verdicts.
Use when the operator types /tempest-help or /tempest-config, or when a seat runs its first session: registers the seat id and checks gateway reachability.
Use when the operator types /tempest-run with an objective: acknowledges with a run id, streams progress, and closes with a completion summary.
Use when the operator starts, parks, resumes, pauses, or stops a mission: owns mission ids and the parked/resumable lifecycle.
Use when the operator types /tempest-agents or tasks a seat: lists operators and dispatches work to one operator id.
Use when the operator types /tempest-status or /tempest-providers: reads mission status plus provider and subscription-session state.
Use when the operator types /tempest-report: exports the engagement report for a mission id.
Use when the operator recalls past work or reviews learned entries: reads the memory capsule and accepts or rejects proposals.
Use when the operator types /black-specter with a red plan: critiques the plan's covert tradecraft, cover, and noise budget from the adversary's eyes.
Use when the operator types /black-wraith with exfil paths: simulates the paths as analysis and checks them against the noise budget.
Use when the operator types /blue-sentinel with findings: maps each finding to telemetry and writes one detector recommendation per gap.
Use when the operator types /blue-warden with findings: audits hardening and returns a verification checklist plus misconfiguration call-outs.
Use when the operator types /white-arbiter with an action: returns the ROE verdict on that action and resolves any red versus blue dispute about it.
Use when the operator types /white-auditor with evidence: scores each entry by provenance and aggregates the evidence-strength verdict.
Use when the operator types /dark-purple with a mission scope: runs the full loop of red findings to black pressure to blue detection to white verdict to report.
